sv.title: Avslöjar sanningen om drottning Elizabeths favoritbarn
sv.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor har länge ansetts vara drottning Elizabeths favoritbarn. Helt fel, enligt hovets tidigare presschef Dickie Arbiter. I en podd avslöjar han vem hon verkligen gillade bäst.

en.title: Reveals the truth about Queen Elizabeth's favourite child
en.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor has long been considered Queen Elizabeth's favourite child. Completely wrong, according to the palace's former press secretary Dickie Arbiter. In a podcast he reveals who she really liked best.
